description: This file defines an abstract base class for various bar code representations within the PDFsharp library. It includes factory methods for creating barcode objects of specific types, properties related to barcode configuration, and an abstract render method to be implemented by subclasses.

classes.name: BarCode
classes.description: Abstract base class for barcode representations, providing common properties, factory methods, and rendering framework.

methods.name: FromType
methods.description: Factory methods to create barcode instances based on specified barcode type, with various overloads for different parameters.
